summary.text: Courtney Waters is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 113, in office since April 1, 2025, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Courtney Waters earned a bachelor's degree from Rhodes College in 2011 and a graduate degree from the University of Mississippi in 2013.

Her career experience includes work as managing director of Teach for America, South Carolina, and she has been affiliated with the Tuscaloosa Chamber of Commerce, Teacher's Supply Closet, and the Medi Community Resource Center.
Waters served on the Charleston County School District school board from 2020 to 2024.
She succeeded Marvin Pendarvis as the District 113 representative and is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee for 2025-2026.
